business_summary: Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd engages in the development, production, and sale of dairy products, breeding and cultivation of dairy cows, and logistics and distribution activities in China and internationally. It offers fresh milk and yogurt, UHT milk and yogurt, lactic acid bacteria drinks, frozen desserts, cheese, butter, and other products, as well as milk powder for infants, and middle-aged and elderly people. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Guangming Dairy Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd in 2003. The company was founded in 1911 and is based in Shanghai, China. Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Bright Food (Group) Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd는 중국 및 국제적으로 유제품 개발, 생산 및 판매, 젖소 사육 및 재배, 물류 및 유통 활동에 종사하고 있습니다. 신선한 우유와 요거트, UHT 우유와 요거트, 유산균 음료, 냉동디저트, 치즈, 버터 등의 제품과 유아, 중장년층을 위한 분유 등을 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Shanghai Guangming Dairy Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2003년에 Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1911년에 설립되었으며 중국 상하이에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd는 Bright Food (Group) Co., Ltd.의 자회사입니다.
